Tree over roadway.

Tree down.

Tree down on power line causing a small fire.

Social media report of flooding issues on roads including South Frederica St.

69 mph wind gust recorded by the ASOS at Southern Illinois Airport. A Cesna 177 (unoccupied) was flipped over.

Flooding issues were reported on Pottertown Road.
Bucher Road in Mounds has a considerable amount of water over it and at least one residence is being evacuated due to water coming into home.
Trees blown down along Highway 160 3 miles west of US 67.
A tree was downed on County Rd 700 E. A powerline was downed in West Salem.
Power lines down near the intersection of Miller and Missouri streets in Bloomfield.
Tree down along Highway 114 east of Highway BB.
Tree blown across the road at Scillion Drive and Lone Valley Road.
Tree down across S Gilmore Ave.
Camper blown over at Venture River Water Park. Nickel-sized hail also reported in Eddyville.
Roofs blown off multiple buildings in Eddyville. Tree into powerlines as well.
The roof was blown off of a barn_ and some tree limbs down in Wyatt.
Multiple trees were downed in Spencer County_ with reports mainly coming from Grandview.
A large barn collapsed due to thunderstorm winds in Grandview.
Water over Highway 348 in several places around Benton.
Multiple trees downed by thunderstorm winds west of Cadiz.
Multiple trees downed by thunderstorm winds in Cadiz.
Bucher Road in Mounds has at least 6 inches of water over it. Several other rounds in Mounds and Mound City also have water over them.
Numerous roads with water over them in the northern part of Ballard County north of Hwy 60.
Tree blown down near Hwy E east of Greenville.
Water flowing over road at intersection of South Illinois Ave and Cherry St.
Several streets were flooded in Cairo_ along with flooding near the viaduct.
Water over Hwy 51 south of Anna near Balcom Road.
Water over Hwy 51 in Dongola.
Flooding of Hwy A near US-61.
Scott City police department flooded. Multiple roads flooded in Scott County.
Vehicles submerged in Cape Girardeau at Bloomfield and Kings Highway.
Several washouts have occurred across Massac County due to flash flooding.
